gundi's split isolates 'Jm Thon: Kompt her zu mir ...' as a tune cross-reference (OTHER_TITLE) from the main title, and both spans cleanly exclude trailing truncation/typography markers; complexity of this pre-1700 broadside warrants low confidence.

Guide §3.1 states exactly one TITLE per record, ruling out gundi's two-TITLE split; frankp's trailing period on 'Soldaten.' is ordinary sentence punctuation, not a separator, so it stays in TITLE.
